help.secretKey:
Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys → “Create restricted key” (rk_…). Set these permissions:
• Checkout Sessions: Write
• Refunds: Write
• Webhook Endpoints: Write
• Accounts: Read (optional, only for the account name)
Everything else: None. We create the webhook automatically.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Start for free.
pricing.text: roots is free during the beta. After that you pay per module you use – not per seat and not per member.

q1.a: Clubs, venues, festivals, collectives and small organisations that manage members, events or money and need several tools for it today.

q2.a: On servers in the EU. Every organisation is strictly separated from the others, and you can export everything anytime.

q3.q: Can we move from Excel or our old software?
q3.a: Yes. Contacts and members can be imported via CSV, including member numbers and bank details. roots maps the columns for you.

q4.q: How does ticket money reach us?
q4.a: Directly in your own Stripe or SumUp account. roots never holds money. Dues are collected through a SEPA file via your own bank.

q5.q: What will roots cost after the beta?
q5.a: You pay per module you use. Prices are set before the beta ends, nobody is switched over without being asked.

q6.q: Can we keep our own website?
q6.a: Yes. With the public API your website shows events, tickets and forms directly – buying and signing up run through roots. Or simply use our ready-made pages.

final.title: Start today,
final.text: Free during the beta, no credit card. You can take your data with you anytime.
